title: Finite product coordinates for additive alternating Cech complexes
statement: Let Y and S be schemes, V_i a finite family of opens of Y, G a presheaf of global-ring modules, and H an additive functor from modules over Gamma(Y,O) to module sheaves on S. For L obtained by applying H to the alternating section complex extended to integer degrees [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex], there are additive equivalences on every open B of S from L in degree p to the product over increasing tuples t of sections on B of H(G(intersection V_t)). They commute with restriction of B, are Gamma(B,O)-linear, and send the differential to the signed sum of the H-images of coefficient face restrictions. This includes empty products.

proof.text: The function module in degree p is the explicit categorical product of its coefficient modules by ModuleCat.productConeIsLimit. The additive functor followed by section evaluation preserves finite products; isLimitFanMkObjOfIsLimit and conePointUniqueUpToIso give the bijectivity of the projection map. Compose it with the section map of H applied to extendXIso. Every coordinate is the section map of a module-sheaf morphism, giving naturality and local linearity.

Expand the explicitly defined alternatingCechDifferential and compose it with each projection. This is a finite sum of signed coefficient restriction maps composed with projections. Use extend_d_eq, functoriality, and additivity of H to transport the equality to L. Evaluation of morphisms on sections is additive, so evaluating this equality gives the asserted signed sum.

proof_origin.note: Fully proved in Lean by finite product universal properties and explicit expansion of the differential.

theorem additive_alternatingCech_coordinates {Y S : Scheme.{u}} {r : ℕ}
    (V : Fin r → Y.Opens)
    (G : Y.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, ⊤))
    (H : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, ⊤) ⥤ S.Modules) [H.Additive] :
    let L := (H.mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
      ((alternatingCechComplex V G).extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
    ∃ e : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : S.Opens), Γ(L.X (p : ℤ), B) ≃+
        (∀ t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r,
          Γ(H.obj (G.obj (op (alternatingCechIntersection V t))), B)),
      (∀ (p : ℕ) {B C : S.Opens} (i : B ⟶ C)
        (s : Γ(L.X (p : ℤ), C)) (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r),
        e p B ((L.X (p : ℤ)).presheaf.map i.op s) t =
          (H.obj (G.obj (op (alternatingCechIntersection V t)))).presheaf.map i.op
            (e p C s t)) ∧
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (B : S.Opens) (b : Γ(S, B))
        (s : Γ(L.X (p : ℤ), B)) (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r),
        e p B (b • s) t = b • e p B s t) ∧
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (B : S.Opens) (s : Γ(L.X (p : ℤ), B))
        (t : Fin (p + 2) ↪o Fin r),
        e (p + 1) B ((L.d (p : ℤ) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).app B s) t =
          ∑ j : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ j.val •
            (H.map (G.map (homOfLE
              (alternatingCechIntersection_face_le V p t j)).op)).app B
                (e p B s ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb j).trans t)))
